status: User-confirmed one Bone Discovered wheel, approximately 32 animals, modern zero and older/stronger packages 1..3 points; Paraceratherium name confirmed. Exact roster/packages remain editable authored curation.

confirmed: Spin Bone Discovered from about 32 animals spanning different timelines.
Order choices by distance from present day and how common they are.
Current-timeline animal discoveries grant no bonus.
Older and stronger animal discoveries grant packages worth +1..+3 in power, stats or combinations.
User explicitly confirms Paraceratherium as the intended animal on 2026-10-09.
authority.existingPolicy: Unspecified odds equal; 1 power is valued at 2 numeric stat points under the prior user-defined budget convention.
authoredInterpretations: Use broad representative finding timeline groups newest to oldest, then editable familiarity/commonness ordering inside each group. Commonness is display curation, not a measured population/fossil frequency or unequal probability.
A modern animal is a present-timeline discovery, regardless of how ancient its evolutionary lineage is; no retrospective dinosaur bonus from Chicken.
Apply one fixed bounded package at actual finding result, not another age/strength/power selector.

contracts.order: Actual Archaeologist role/reaction -> one Bone Discovered spin -> commit finding reference and its exact bounded stat/power package -> reaction with known reward -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: Exactly 32 current draft outcomes, base weight 1 each, probability 1/32 = 3.125%. Ordering, scientific age, authored power/strength tier and commonness do not bias odds. Slayer count-only 5% floor does not apply here.
contracts.ordering: Stable displayOrder; broad represented timeline group is primary, familiarity/commonness curation secondary. Eras overlap across taxa; this is not exact specimen dating, the complete taxon lifetime, earliest clade origin or a universally measured abundance rank.
contracts.budget: Current timeline zero. Past discoveries package budget 1..3: sum of positive integer numeric main-stat buffs + 2 per granted power. Budget is metadata/validation, never an extra all-stat bonus. +1 = one point on a main stat; +2 = two stat points or one power; +3 = three stat points or one power plus one stat point.
contracts.ageStrength: Age alone does not force maximum reward. Authored packages consider represented era and animal prowess together: small ancient Coelophysis/Eohippus can be +1, robust/predatory extinct animals +2, selected formidable ancient giants +3. Exact allocation remains editable rather than a numerical biological strength formula.
contracts.ownership: Finding is a separate narrative discovery reference. No animal becomes a Race component, pet, summoned creature, weapon, Dwarf armor item, body/Size replacement or actual revived animal. Do not dispatch target Race/Animal Transformation/events or consume usedRaceFamilyIds.
contracts.stat: Apply the declared numeric modifiers once after immutable main-stat bases without numeric clamps; do not add the budget value separately.
contracts.power: Fixed intrinsic finding-linked power grants; no additional Power/Element/Cosmic selector. Bind discovery animal as visual/theme provenance, without powers/stats from other animals or unapproved transformations. Powers persist after main Power None and use one ordinary shared Power Mastery; no rank boost, Authority override or Enchant.
contracts.ledger: Freeze version/catalog, display pool and exact finding packages before seeded spin. Commit result/reference/grants/stat effects and consumed source ledger key atomically once. Replay uses the stored package without redraw or current catalog re-query.
contracts.reaction: Narrator knows the actual finding and its deterministic package after the finding commit. Modern result still gets a result/reaction and continues without bonus/reroll. Joke caption and fixed rewards are not extra spins or new funny-result mechanics tags.
contracts.source: Primary museum/research sources establish broad fauna/timeline/anatomy context only. Fantasy ability definitions, stat packages, commonness ordering and gameplay budget are authored, not scientific claims.
